data.body: The docstring (line 16) states "Zero disables inline findings," but `limit = max_findings or DEFAULT_MAX_FINDINGS` treats `0` as falsy, so `select_review_findings(findings, 0)` silently falls back to `DEFAULT_MAX_FINDINGS` (20) and returns up to 20 items instead of `[]`. This contradicts the documented contract and would defeat a caller's intent to fully disable findings. Only `None` should trigger the default; distinguish it explicitly from `0`, e.g. `limit = DEFAULT_MAX_FINDINGS if max_findings is None else max_findings`.
